flags.title: OLBG start times carry no zone label and mix conventions inside the same capture
flags.detail: The same hub list rendered 12:12 for a 17:12 Towcester race (a US-Eastern rendering), 14:45 for URC fixtures the URC itself publishes as 14:45 local UK/Irish time, and 16:00 for a Formula 1 race whose track time at Austin is 16:00. No page states a timezone. Times were therefore published verbatim and never converted to UTC.

flags.title: OLBG minute field is corrupted for on-the-hour NHL starts
flags.detail: OLBG shows 'Today 20:07' for Montreal at Chicago. The NHL's own feed gives 2026-10-24T00:00:00Z, which is 20:00 Eastern. Every on-the-hour NHL row on the hub carries :07 minutes, so the minute field cannot be trusted.

flags.title: The NHL feed embeds mutually contradictory prices for the same outcome
flags.detail: For game 2026020166 the feed gives Montreal 2.35 (decimal), 1.60 and 2.03 on three providers but -170, -170 and -162 on three others; Chicago is simultaneously 1.59 and +138. One set makes Chicago the favourite, the other makes Montreal the favourite. Only the three American-quote providers were used, and the contradiction is disclosed on every affected row.

flags.title: OLBG lists far more NHL games than the league has scheduled today
flags.detail: The hub listed at least fifteen NHL fixtures under 'Today', but the NHL schedule for 2026-10-23 contains exactly two games (numberOfGames=2). Expired rows are left in the list and no expired badge was shown, so an OLBG row is not evidence that a game is still to come.

flags.title: URC page names the same clubs two different ways on one page
flags.detail: The Round 4 fixture block prints 'Hollywoodbets Sharks', '10bet Lions', 'Connacht Rugby' and 'Edinburgh Rugby'; the Round 3 results block on the same page prints 'Sharks', 'Lions', 'Connacht' and 'Edinburgh'. A six-entry alias table is the only name mapping used in this desk and it is published with the code.

flags.title: Golf returned zero events — the covered sport has no discoverable match list today
flags.detail: The OLBG golf hub rendered 'No tips found.' at 16:20Z. No tournament, no field and no price can be offered. Nothing was substituted from another source.

flags.title: Rugby League has no fixtures at all on OLBG, only 2027 outrights
flags.detail: The hub carried State of Origin 2027, Super League 2027 and NRL 2027 only. The 2026 Rugby League World Cup knockout stage falls in this window but is not listed, so the brief's five-match target cannot be attempted from OLBG discovery.

flags.title: pdc.tv returns a consent wall instead of match content
flags.detail: The European Championship tournament page returned a CookieYes consent dialog and no schedule. Fourteen darts rows are therefore discovery-only. The same barrier was recorded by session 8f6d7364 on 2026-10-22 as F-8F6D-03.

flags.title: WST match list is reachable but does not reach today's session in one capture
flags.detail: wst.tv/matches returned the Northern Ireland Open list, but the first chunk covers 18-19 October. It confirms Round 1 results for Scott Donaldson (4-0 over Wu Yize) and David Gilbert (4-1 over Oliver Sykes) yet says nothing about the 23 October matches, which are not verified and therefore unpriced.

flags.title: Both basketball routes failed to expose fixtures
flags.detail: The EuroLeague game centre is client-rendered and returns a club list with no dates; cdn.nba.com returned HTTP 500. Fourteen basketball rows are discovery-only.

flags.title: The nine OLBG tennis rows carry no competition, and the tours list different matches
flags.detail: OLBG routes every tennis row through /All_Tennis/All_Events/ with no tournament name. The ATP current-scoreboard page at the same moment lists Brussels and Lyon quarter-finals, none of which match the OLBG pairings. The WTA scores page is client-rendered. No tennis fixture could be tied to an official draw.

flags.title: Cricket Australia page returned filters, not fixtures
flags.detail: cricket.com.au/matches rendered series and team filter lists only in the first capture. The seven domestic and international cricket rows remain discovery-only; no cricket total, handicap or winner price is published.

flags.title: Munster GAA fixture detail sits behind sub-pages that were not reached
flags.detail: The fixtures index returned navigation only. The four club fixtures (Cork, Galway, Limerick) are therefore unverified, including the St Finbarrs v Nemo Rangers game scheduled for 25 October.

flags.title: Live MLB standings returned one division in the first capture
flags.detail: The fresh standings call put NL East clubs in the first chunk, so Milwaukee's record was taken from the repository's canonical 2026-10-22 capture of the same endpoint. The value cannot have changed because the 162-game season is complete, but the observation is one day old and is labelled as such.

flags.title: OLBG club and player spellings differ from official names
flags.detail: 'Nissa' for Nice, 'Newcastle Red Bulls' for the Newcastle Premiership club, 'William OConnor' for William O'Connor, 'Pays dAix UC' and 'EHC Munchen'. Names are reproduced as published on OLBG rows and never silently corrected.

flags.title: No injury, suspension or availability information was obtained for any fixture
flags.detail: None of the official pages reached this session published a team news, injury or suspension list. No prediction asserts one. This is the single largest gap against the brief.

flags.title: Zero High-confidence selections today, and the reason is structural
flags.detail: The rule as written needs a probability of at least 70% AND an American price no shorter than -250, which bounds the eligible band to 70.0-71.4%. Only six fixtures could be confirmed on an official page, and the strongest of them (Edinburgh, 85%) prices at -567, outside the window. Nothing was reclassified to manufacture a High.

flags.title: Greyhound runners are unverified and cannot be checked against GBGB data
flags.detail: Fifteen race rows with dog names were discovered. GBGB publishes meeting and open-race calendars, not per-race runner lists, and no GBGB page was fetched this session. No greyhound selection is priced.

flags.title: 107 indicative prices exist and none of them is evidence
flags.detail: Where no official input was available, an indicative price was still published so that every discovered match has a number rather than a silent blank. It is a 50% shrunk OLBG tip share, capped at 0.90, permanently graded Low, and marked 'indicative' on every row. It must not be read as a probability or as a tip.
